newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GBL mulls stock brokerage unit's fate.
newsitem.headline: GBL mulls stock brokerage unit's fate.

text.p: Belgian holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert said on Tuesday it was considering whether its stock brokerage unit Groupe Dewaay could continue to go it alone or if it needed a partner.

"We are wondering whether Dewaay can remain in its current form or join a partner. At the moment no decisions have been taken," GBL chief executive officer Didier Bellens told the annual shareholders meeting.
Bellens said talks about Dewaay's future had been going on for several months between GBL and the brokerage's management.
"It's all going on under good relations," Bellens said.

Belgian financial daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd said in May 1996 that Dewaay was holding merger talks with small, privately held Belgian merchant bank Degroof. -- Nick Antonovics, Brussels Newsroom ((+32 2 287 6817, Fax +32 2 230 7710))
